theorems.name: Submission.c1approx_measurable_remainder_modulus
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0) (C : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n), LipschitzWith K f → Measurable ν → ∃ η : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ, (∀ k, Measurable (η k)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) → |f y - f x - inner ℝ (ν x) (y - x)| ≤ η k x * ‖y - x‖) ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ (ν x)) x → Tendsto (fun k ↦ η k x) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
